newsitem.title: USA: Getty says fuel spin-off non-taxable.
newsitem.headline: Getty says fuel spin-off non-taxable.

text.p: Getty Petroleum Corp said on Monday the Internal Revenue Service ruled that a spin-off of the company's motor fuel marketing business would be non-taxable to Getty shareholders.
The spin-off would be effective as of January 31, 1997, when the fiscal year ends, Getty said in a statement.

Getty President and Chief Executive Officer Leo Liebowitz said in a statement that while an exact exchange ratio had not been set, shareholders of record were expected to receive a dividend of about one share in the new company, Getty Petroleum Marketing Inc for each share of Getty Petroleum Corp.
Liebowitz said he was enthusiastic about the IRS ruling because separating the fuel marketing business would let each division take advantage of its specific growth opportunities.
There were a substantial number of spin-off related matters to be accomplished, he said.
